integrity: All necessary and sufficient Jacobi and mixed-Jacobi equations are derived from arbitrary coefficients; a rank-three vector-bundle stratification gives the exact geometric and arithmetic assertions. Finite-field enumeration is independent replay evidence, not the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The first Lie bracket is a chosen, fixed three-dimensional Heisenberg bracket.
Counts are of individual alternating second brackets on a fixed vector space, not isomorphism classes.
Only the reduced compatibility variety is classified; unreduced scheme structure and tangent cohomology are not determined.
Equivalent formulas may occur in older Lie-pencil literature not indexed under compatible-bracket terminology.
title: Two components and exact counts for Heisenberg-compatible Lie brackets
